summary: Elevate your career with our Real Estate Management and Virtual Assets Training Course. Gain essential skills and knowledge for success in today's market.
lede: Real estate and virtual asset management helps property, facilities, finance, and procurement professionals make evidence-based decisions across asset lifecycles. It develops skills to classify portfolios, monitor occupancy and costs, plan maintenance and capital spending, evaluate lease or disposal options, and communicate recommendations with performance dashboards and business cases. It also explains digital twins, tokenization, digital ownership records, and related risks such as fraud, speculation, compliance, and custodianship.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals responsible for managing property portfolios, facilities, leases, valuation inputs, asset registers, and emerging digital/virtual asset decisions.
modules: Property Portfolio Strategy and Asset Classification
Leasing, Tenant Management, and Occupancy Optimization
Budgeting, Capex Planning, and Lifecycle Cost Control
Valuation, Performance Metrics, and Reporting Dashboards
Risk, Compliance, and Governance in Real Estate
Digital Transformation in Real Estate Operations
Understanding Virtual Assets in a Real Estate Context
Decision-Making and Business Case Development for Asset Actions
Sustainability, ESG, and Future-Proofing Real Estate Assets
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate principles and basic financial literacy. Familiarity with digital tools and asset management concepts is beneficial but not required.
